_comment: Monitor layout rules for this machine, read by labyrinth-displays. 'match' is a case-insensitive substring of the monitor's description or model as Hyprland reports it (from the EDID: Windows reported 'ACR X34 GS' and 'GSM LG SDQHD'). Positions are in Hyprland's logical pixels, i.e. after scaling. The values below copy the Windows arrangement on 2026-10-10: ultrawide at 0,0; the tall LG DualUp (2560x2880 native, shown at 125% = 2048x2304) to its right with its top 783 px above the ultrawide's top edge. Hyprland's connector names are not known until a real boot, so rules never name them. Edit ~/.config/labyrinth/displays.json to override.
